error[ZBX-E0103]: cgroup v2 is not set up for this user
  cause  the bus answered 'REJECTED EXTERNAL' to EXTERNAL authentication as this
         user: the socket may belong to another user (an inherited
         DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS after su or sudo)
  fix    unset an address inherited from another user:   unset DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS
         or log in again as this user, through a systemd (logind) session
  more   zbx explain E0103 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0103.html
